tasks.title: archive.py 재실행 시 스냅샷 중복 조회 문제 해소 + ARCHIVE_COLUMN_ORDER 하드코딩 회귀 수정

tasks.resolution: fetch_archive_snapshot에 latest_only=True(기본값) 추가 -- (스냅샷_날짜,종목코드) 그룹 내 snapshot_timestamp 최댓값만 남기고 반환, latest_only=False로 전체 이력 그대로 조회 가능(저장소 원본은 전혀 삭제 안 함). upsert_archive_snapshot은 같은 날짜 재실행 감지 시 INFO 로그로 명시. check 과정에서 tests/unit/daily/test_archive.py의 ARCHIVE_COLUMN_ORDER 길이 하드코딩(==26) 회귀 4곳 발견(지난 orderbook_snapshot_collection 스펙에서 37로 늘었으나 그때는 archive.py가 수정대상이 아니라 lean_check selective 테스트 범위에서 누락됨) -- 실제 출력값 대 스키마 상수 비교로 수정.
tasks.impact: export_archive.py/archive_intraday.py 등 기존 호출부는 코드 변경 없이 자동으로 중복 제거된 뷰를 받음. lean_check 전체 PASS, Tier2 결함 없음.

tasks.title: Close-morning 익일 익절 청산 규칙 리서치/평가 레이어
tasks.why: 리랭커는 데이터로 재확인된 포화 상태(rankIC 0.20, top-1 net ~1.35%/일, 모든 목적함수·모델클래스가 huber 기본값 못 이김). 코드에 청산 모델이 전무해 net_return을 익일 시가 매도로 고정 사용. 익일 next_high가 시가보다 크게 위(오라클 +8%/일)라 청산 타이밍에 미탐색 헤드룸 존재.
tasks.resolution: src/ml/exit_policy.py 신설(robust_eval.py와 동급 리서치 모듈): attach_next_day_path(익일 OHLC 조인), simulate_take_profit_exit(무-룩어헤드 지정가+MOC 폴백, 결정론적/시드 체결모델), evaluate_exit_grid(CPCV 만장일치 경로 + moving-block bootstrap 승격 게이트), summarize_exit_grid. champion.py train_tuned_champion_bundle에 배선 -> tuning_provenance['exit_policy_grid'] 기록 전용, 서빙/번들 런타임 불변. 실데이터 결과: TP 5%/MOC = +0.84%/일 vs 현행 +0.43%, Δ +41bp p=0.0024, 28개 CPCV 경로 전부 양(+). 보수적 체결가정(85% 체결,-0.3%)에서는 Δ +23bp p=0.11로 유의성 소멸 -> 실체결률 측정이 승격 선결과제.
tasks.impact: 리랭커 피처 연구 동결 유지. 신규 청산 레버는 결정론적 가정 하 게이트 통과했으나 배포 안 함(별도 승격 ADR 필요). champion 번들 provenance에 exit_policy_grid 키 추가, price_history_df=None이면 status:skipped로 기존 동작 불변.

tasks.title: 리랭커 신규 예측정보 탐색 CPCV 기각 + build_ml_dataset 벡터화
tasks.why: ml-res.md '리랭커 포화, 새 예측정보만 레버' 명제를 독립 검증. 5개 신규 횡단면 피처군(A 후보출현동학 B 당일밀집도 C 인과레짐prior D 종목별 오버나잇 미시구조 E 공시트레일링) + LGBMRanker(lambdarank) 전부 CPCV(8,2) 유의성 게이트(delta>0 & p<0.10) 미통과. B(+0.104%/d p=0.054 WF) D(+0.110%/d p=0.109 WF) 마진신호는 CPCV에서 p=0.18/0.92로 소멸, 결합시 붕괴(D+E p=0.92)=검증노이즈. 날짜상수 피처(v_kospi 등 6개)는 당일 횡단면 리랭커에 원리적 무효. build_ml_dataset 초기 측정 90-142s는 uv-run 콜드스타트+머신부하 환경요인이고 실제 컴퓨트는 ~5.5s(_apply_robust_z 2.6s + create_multi_targets 2.0s 지배).
tasks.resolution: 신규 알파 코드변경 없음(탐색결과 음성). _apply_robust_z: groupby.transform(lambda MAD)를 벡터 MAD((x-median).abs().groupby.transform(median))로 교체 + N개 _z 컬럼 단일 df.assign 일괄부착(프레임 조각화 회피). 2.6s->0.04s, rtol=1e-12 패리티. create_multi_targets: trade_date 그룹 파이썬 랭크 루프를 그룹크기별 단일 qcut 벡터화로 교체, target_rank 33827행 loop구현과 정확일치. 신규 테스트 test_features_robust_z.py / test_build_perf.py(slow) 추가. 출력 bit-identical, 레거시 컬럼 패리티 불변.
tasks.impact: 리랭커 알파: 모델/블렌드/정책/가중/윈도우/앙상블/관망 게이트에 이어 신규 예측정보(피처군 5종)+모델클래스(ranker)도 소진 확인 -> 리랭커 피처 연구 동결 권고. 다음 레버는 후보생성기 품질(oracle top1 +6.6% vs 실현 +0.6%) 또는 트레이드구성(quantile grade 사이징/청산타이밍)이며 src/ml/ 밖. 파이프라인: build_ml_dataset 컴퓨트 ~5.5s->~1.5s, HPO 40 trial x inner CV 및 cpcv_oof_predict 에서 수백회 복리. 하위호환: 시그니처/컬럼셋/값 불변.

tasks.title: Recover reranker model alpha cancelled by champion pipeline: fix blend-weight selection bug + regularized default model
tasks.why: 튜닝만으로 라이브러리 기본값 대비 개선 없던 정확한 원인 규명: calibrate_blend_weight 가 MDD 노이즈로 p_good 가중 0.75(최선 0.0 대비 -17bp) 선택하는 버그 + RUN A/B 가 검증-무효 knob(date_balanced p=0.99, recency p=0.31)과 혼동. 배경: 후보군 EV 가 2020년 이후 붕괴(+0.3%/53% -> -0.2%/44% win)로 리랭커가 현 레짐에서 포화.
tasks.resolution: calibrate_blend_weight 유의성 게이트 재작성(최저 grid 가중 기본, 상위는 moving_block_bootstrap delta>0 & p<promotion_alpha 일 때만 채택, MDD tiebreaker 삭제; per_weight 에 delta_vs_base/p_value_vs_base 추가). bundle.py CHAMPION_DEFAULT_MODEL_PARAMS 상수(num_leaves 15 등 정규화 config)를 build_inline_bundle 기본층으로 병합. ChampionTuningConfig.model_params_override + retrain --no-hpo 로 Optuna 스킵. _CLOSE_MORNING_RERANKER_CONFIG p_good_weight 0.5->0.0. 실데이터 검증: 블렌드 선택 0.0 정상 동작(기존 버그 0.75), 그러나 홀드아웃 승격 게이트 미통과(FIXED +3.7bp p=0.57, HPO +6.0bp p=0.41, MDD 오히려 악화). 격리 ablation +24bp/p=0.0004 는 OOS 예약에서 소멸.
tasks.impact: 선택 버그 제거(모든 tuned 챔피언이 MDD 노이즈로 가중 선택하던 문제). 배포 비-tuned 모델이 bare LightGBM 기본값 대신 정규화 prior 사용. 블렌드 가중 유의성 기반 결정. 하위호환(positional 시그니처/BlendWeightResult 불변, --no-hpo 없으면 기존과 동일). 모델/블렌드/정책 튜닝은 현 레짐에서 소진 — 다음 레버는 새 예측정보(로드맵 P2).

tasks.title: Sparse-data ML robustness: CPCV eval + significance-gated promotion + reg-biased HPO
tasks.why: 희소 패널(중앙값 12후보/일)에서 기존 평균비교 승격 게이트가 검증된 +16-18% 개선을 노이즈로 판정(p=0.82). alpha는 안정적(연도별 rankIC ~0.18)이며 병목은 평가 파워.
tasks.resolution: src/ml/robust_eval.py 신규(CombinatorialPurgedCV/cpcv_oof_predict/path_top1_returns/moving_block_bootstrap_delta/deflated_sharpe_ratio). champion.py evaluate_promotion 유의성 게이트(delta>0 & p<promotion_alpha). tuning.py eval_mode(walkforward|cpcv, _objective OOF 라우팅 스위치)/cpcv_n_groups/cpcv_k_test/promotion_alpha/hpo_reg_bias + cpcv_top1 목적함수(경로분산 페널티). retrain.py --eval-mode/--hpo-objective/--promotion-alpha. 실데이터 검증: A(rank_ic) p=0.358, B(cpcv_top1) p=0.665 둘 다 승격 거부 - 현 61피처로 튜닝만으론 방어 가능한 개선 없음.
tasks.impact: 승격 게이트가 bootstrap 유의성 기준(p<0.10)으로 전환, 노이즈 승격 차단. 기본 경로 하위호환(walkforward/rank_ic). CPCV(8,2)=28fold/7path 평가 인프라 확보. cpcv_oof_predict attrs concat 버그 + eval_mode ghost-switch 수정.

tasks.title: 근거기반 섹터 재정의 + nested 안정성필터 피처선택 + HPO 목적함수 rank_ic 전환
tasks.why: 44개 주관 테마 분류의 후보패널-내 섹터평균이 39.1% 행에서 정확히 0(자기비교)이고 단독 rankIC -0.0071, 순열중요도 49위로 퇴화. theme.parquet 정적 스냅샷의 미래 라벨 누수. 77피처 중 21개가 순열 rankIC 기여 <=0. SHAP 은 일내 상수 피처(v_kospi)를 6위로 과대평가. HPO 목적 top1_return 은 하루 1관측 고분산.
tasks.resolution: src/ml/sector_features.py: 연1회 재적합 상관 KMeans point-in-time 클러스터(무누수: Y라벨은 Y-01-01 이전만) + 전체시장 멤버십 기준 sector_mkt_ret/breadth/mom_5d(mom_5d 는 shift(1) 엄격 트레일링). src/ml/feature_selection.py: 일자그룹내 순열 rankIC 하락 중요도 + fold내부(train만) nested 선택 + min_folds 안정성필터. dataset.py feature_set='close_morning_sector' 가산(퇴화 sector_relative_change 제거). tuning.py hpo_objective 기본값 rank_ic + feature_selection_top_n/min_folds config. champion/retrain 배선. min_obs 150->120·lookback 500->550(정상국면 커버리지). pytest-timeout dev 의존성 등록.
tasks.impact: close_morning_sector coverage 39.1%결손→정상국면 87.5~94.7%. train_tuned_champion_bundle 실행: 피처선택 81→25(섹터 5종 전부 nested 탈락, history 6종 생존), HPO best inner rankIC 0.238, dev 게이트 PASS(+4.6bp). 미사용 OOS(2025-07~2026-08, 123일): 챔피언 top1 +0.496%/Sharpe2.15/MDD23.3% vs tuned-61 +0.243%/1.11/30.3% — 방향 긍정이나 p=0.36 무의미, 라이브러리기본 baseline(+0.606%)에 미달. 운영 승격 불가, OOS 확대 필요.

Optuna 중첩 purged walk-forward 튜닝, seed 앙상블, OOF 기반 p_good blend 가중치 보정, 라벨 클립/Huber δ config화, chronological 확률 보정기, date-balanced·recency 가중 A/B, 임베고 OOS 예약 + 동일 날짜 대조군 승격 게이트 구현. src.ml.* mypy override 추가.

tasks.title: Theme & Market Auto-Resolver with Local Parquet Zero-GSheet Architecture
tasks.why: Eliminated manual Google Sheet intervention and subjective theme labeling by establishing fully automated KIS/Naver-based classification with local Parquet caching and ML train-serve consistency.
tasks.resolution: Built src/data/theme_resolver.py with 4-tier hybrid resolution, updated collect.py and predict.py to use local theme.parquet caching, removed Google Sheets theme sync dependencies, and updated 33,000+ historical trade logs.
tasks.impact: Zero manual intervention between collect and predict, 40ms inference latency, 100% test pass across 247 tests, and full ML train-serve feature integrity.

tasks.title: 실시간 상따 피처 파이프라인 및 가격 정합성 복구
tasks.why: 실시간 서빙 시 상따 시나리오 종목의 11개 원-핫/컨텍스트 피처 누락(0.0 주입) 및 상따 가격(close/buy_price) 미동기화로 인한 파생 피처 왜곡이 발생함.
tasks.resolution: features.py에 고정 8종 시나리오 one-hot 및 3종 context 수치 피처 생성기를 구현하고 predict.py에서 상따 가격 동기화 로직을 보강함.
tasks.impact: 배포된 61개 피처 모델 번들과의 Training-Serving Skew가 100% 해소되고 상따 시나리오의 가격/수익률 피처 정합성이 보장됨.

tasks.title: Separate live ML serving from legacy research
tasks.why: The daily runtime imported training, OOF, and experiment code and could retrain or mutate model artifacts during live inference; archived research also remained in the active source and test trees.
tasks.resolution: Moved the live inference boundary to src/serving/realtime, renamed runtime APIs to model-bundle, snapshot-feature, and daily-sizing terminology, archived research under ignored legacy/, removed legacy files from the Git index while preserving them on disk, and updated code maps, specs, and tooling exclusions.
tasks.impact: Live inference now consumes validated published bundles without automatic retraining; the default test and type/lint scope is smaller and clearer, while legacy research remains explicitly runnable from the working tree. Active regression coverage remains green.

tasks.title: ML history pipeline operational hardening
tasks.why: History construction completed, but sparse lifecycle events made downstream selection appear stalled; repeated cold builds also increased runtime and memory risk.
tasks.resolution: Added lifecycle diagnostics, fingerprint-validated atomic history caching, bounded history preparation telemetry, and research-only model-retention controls; confirmed the causal history candidate remains report-only after a completed full pipeline run.
tasks.impact: Warm reruns avoid the cold history build, failures identify the exact stage, OOF and causal evaluation semantics remain unchanged, and no production model artifact is promoted.

tasks.title: ML 평가 무결성 및 날짜 균형 학습 가중치
tasks.why: Feature-selection report evaluation had unverified decision-time provenance and a vacuous control/candidate OOF date gate; row-level loss also overweights action-dense dates.
tasks.resolution: Added fail-closed timestamp provenance, actual paired OOF date comparison, and causal date-balanced Huber sample weighting with nested selection and regression tests.
tasks.impact: Research promotion remains blocked without capture-time provenance; future date-balanced ablations are evaluated with non-vacuous paired OOF gates. No production default is changed.

tasks.title: ML Feature Selection Optimization
tasks.why: The research pipeline truncated positive-gain features at an arbitrary 400-feature cap and used an inaccurate missing-value Spearman approximation.
tasks.resolution: Added fold-local permutation-FWER selection with date-local target permutations, exact pairwise-complete Spearman pruning, deterministic CPU screening metadata, explicit selection provenance, and fail-closed capacity handling.
tasks.impact: Feature selection can derive cardinality from null-calibrated signal instead of silently truncating at 400; OOF and full-training provenance remain separate, with reproducible diagnostics and regression coverage.

tasks.title: Repair causal history feature quality
tasks.why: The 2025-only quality audit found market-context alignment, order-dependent aggregation, zero-denominator flow ratios, misleading two-fold stability, and an under-sourced volume_power feature.
tasks.resolution: Synchronized the causal_history_v2 repairs: deterministic market aggregation, signed-log flow changes, neutral zero-scale z-scores, baseline missing-rate gating, all-fold stability, and effective ma_slope lookback metadata.
tasks.impact: Documentation, task registry, and code map now reflect the verified 2025 cutoff five-fold retraining; the candidate remains report-only because it does not beat control.

tasks.title: Feature engineering quality diagnostics and promotion gate
tasks.why: The 2025 causal-history retrain showed 65 unavailable candidates, 179 capacity-limited candidates, and lower candidate OOF performance despite feature-count expansion.
tasks.resolution: Added fold-local feature quality evidence and deterministic family reports, persisted quality_report in research artifacts, exposed source-incomplete/capacity-limited/unstable actions, and required candidate scheduled mean return to strictly beat the identical-date control before promotion.
tasks.impact: Research now distinguishes unavailable data from redundant or capacity-limited features and prevents lower-return history candidates from promotion; active production artifacts remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Optimize Cold Cache History Panel and Spearman Feature Selection
tasks.why: Cold cache causal panel build and 720 fold-local feature selection timeout blocked ML research discovery runs.
tasks.resolution: Accelerated Spearman correlation matrix calculation via BLAS matrix multiplication and enforced memory-bounded streaming batching to avoid OOM.
tasks.impact: Fold-local feature selection completed within 456s pipeline wall time with Peak RSS 3.79 GiB, preventing timeouts and OOM.

tasks.title: ML training optimization and causal history benchmark
tasks.why: Finalize synchronization after the cold-cache and warm-cache benchmark.
tasks.resolution: Registered the causal cutoff, 25k Arrow batch benchmark, 267.89-second cold panel build, three warm cache reads, and the candidate-selection timeout; removed completed temporary ML training optimization specs.
tasks.impact: ADR and code map are current, benchmark evidence is retained in docs/results, and no production model artifact was promoted.

tasks.title: Causal history feature streaming and research observability
tasks.why: Prepare 720-feature causal history research under WSL memory limits and preserve diagnosable outcomes when long runs terminate.
tasks.resolution: Added bounded Arrow Parquet scans, RSS budget checks, alphanumeric identifier-safe finite sanitization, a research-only CLI, atomic status snapshots, append-only stage events, and failure traceback persistence. Real history/control stages completed under 8 GiB; 5-fold candidate evaluation exceeded the 30-minute timeout and was not promoted.
tasks.impact: Research pipeline is reproducible and memory-bounded for history construction, writes non-production artifacts only, and exposes failure checkpoints; GPU remains opt-in/CPU fallback in the current WSL environment.

tasks.title: ML recency-adaptive dual-horizon ensemble
tasks.why: The p_bad reranker v2 lowered scheduled return without reducing MDD, indicating that post-prediction risk penalties were not fixing the expanding-history return model's regime sensitivity.
tasks.resolution: Implemented fold-local exponential recency weighting for 252/504 trade-date half-lives, a percentile-ranked expanding/recent return ensemble, nested inner/outer purged selection, and opt-in research bundle serving. ML v8 through 2025-12-30 passed the nested OOF gate: scheduled mean 1.5316% to 1.5933%, PF 2.74 to 2.87, Sharpe 6.04 to 6.31, and MDD 33.94% to 25.87%.
tasks.impact: Registers the strongest structural ML candidate to date while keeping production promotion blocked on capture-time provenance, execution slippage, and untouched paper/live OOS validation. The v1 default remains unchanged until those gates pass.

tasks.title: ML risk-aware reranker v2 nested OOF evaluation
tasks.why: The v1 reranker improved return and Sharpe but left close-to-morning MDD unchanged; an existing calibrated p_bad estimate required a causal downside-risk experiment.
tasks.resolution: Implemented p_bad-aware decision scoring with a bounded {0, 0.5, 1.0} penalty grid, nested purged outer/inner walk-forward selection through 2025-12-30, and recorded the real-data v7 result. The penalty was rejected because outer OOF scheduled mean fell from 1.5316% to 1.4726% while MDD stayed 33.94%; v1 remains active and no production bundle was changed.
tasks.impact: Registers the rejected v2 ablation and preserves v1 as the production research candidate; future promotion still requires lower MDD without lower scheduled mean plus untouched paper/live validation under the 0.20% cost contract.

tasks.title: Sync close-to-morning risk reranker implementation and results
tasks.why: The reranker implementation has been validated on the full real-data pipeline and its metrics, serving contract, and policy mapping must be registered.
tasks.resolution: Recorded the 5-fold OOF reranker comparison and bundle contract in docs/results/ml-v6.md; registered the task and refreshed the code map; cleaned completed temporary specs and scratch artifacts.
tasks.impact: The current close-to-morning candidate is reproducibly documented with decision_score semantics, 1-stock-per-day behavior, and explicit research-only promotion gates.

tasks.title: Record latest close-to-morning ML pipeline results
tasks.why: The latest full real-data pipeline execution must be reproducible and documented after the close-to-morning policy implementation.
tasks.resolution: Recorded the base40, snapshot49, and close_morning61 OOF comparison, single-stock policy counts, close-to-morning risk metrics, quality score, and persisted bundle fields in docs/results/ml-v5.md.
tasks.impact: Provides the current evidence for production-readiness decisions while retaining the explicit research-only promotion gate.

tasks.title: Single-stock daily BUY/ABSTAIN policy
tasks.why: The ML strategy targets one new stock per day, but the prior sizing/display path exposed multiple candidates and did not make abstention causal.
tasks.resolution: Added causal OOF single-stock policy calibration, deterministic scenario-action resolution, exactly-one BUY or explicit ABSTAIN decisions, and entry-sequence-only evaluation until an exit ledger exists. The OOF comparison selected always_buy_top1; margin abstention candidates were retained for diagnostics because they reduced scheduled-date return.
tasks.impact: Daily inference now has a single-stock decision contract; model reports distinguish active-trade returns from scheduled-date returns and do not claim portfolio MDD without exit data.

tasks.title: ML v3 calendar and flow feature evaluation
tasks.why: The implemented weekday and order-flow feature candidate required a reproducible OOF comparison against base40 before promotion.
tasks.resolution: Ran identical 5-fold purge-1 scenario_action LightGBM Huber evaluations through 2025-12-30, recorded detailed metrics in docs/results/ml-v3.md, and retained production_calendar_flow as an explicit research candidate because primary returns and Sharpe did not improve.
tasks.impact: production_calendar_flow achieved 1.1097% Top-1 net return, 4.369 Sharpe, and 40.46% MDD versus base40 at 1.1393%, 4.473, and 40.23%; it is not promoted. Task and code-map registries are synchronized.

tasks.title: ML v2 scenario action panel rerun
tasks.why: 동일 날짜·종목의 상따 및 다른 시나리오 중복을 임의 병합하지 않고, 최신 시나리오 행동 패널 구현의 ML 성능과 정책 결과를 2025년까지 재평가해야 했다.
tasks.resolution: scenario_action 패널로 snapshot49 LightGBM Regressor를 5-fold purge1 OOF 재실행하고, 충돌 동일 행동키는 reject, 다중 시나리오는 exclude_multi_scenario로 보수적 종목 패널을 구성했다. 최신 결과를 docs/results/ml-v2.md에 기록했다.
tasks.impact: 2017–2025 OOF Top-1 +1.457%, Sharpe 5.67, MDD 40.72%를 확인했으며 날짜·종목 유일 정책에서도 +1.449%가 유지됐다. 2026년은 제외했고 실제 캡처 시각·독립 OOS·체결비용이 없어 실전 승격은 보류한다.
